name: Arkansas Comic Con
blurb: A comics and pop-culture convention at the Statehouse Convention Center in Little Rock, with celebrity guests and cosplay.

editions.evidence: VXV Events' own events calendar (vxvevents.com/events) lists under its '2027 Events' heading: 'Arkansas Comic Con September 10 - 12 2027, Statehouse Convention Center, Little Rock, AR'.

notes: Confirms the seed's 'Sep 18-20, 2026' (page title 'Arkansas Comic Con | September 18-20, 2026 | Statehouse Convention Center'; FAQ text 'Arkansas Comic Con will take place September 18th - 20th 2026'), but that show ended 2026-09-20, before this 2026-10-05 check window. Same VXV/Wix template as Iron City and South Alabama Comic Con: the 'NWA Comic Con' carousel slide and 'Photo Ops Example.png' are shared cross-site stock assets, not this con's own art. Re-checked 2026-10-05: arkansascomiccon.com itself still shows only the just-concluded Sept 18-20, 2026 run with no next date, but VXV Events' (the organizer's) own master events calendar now lists a confirmed 2027 edition, Sept 10-12, 2027, same venue -- added as the upcoming edition; guests not yet announced (the /guests page still shows 2026's lineup).
